# Bill Layne Insurance Agency
> Independent insurance agency in Elkin & Dobson, NC serving all 100 North Carolina counties since 2005. Our local team compares available carrier options for coverage and value.

## About
Bill Layne Insurance Agency is an independent insurance agency founded in 2005 by Bill Layne, a licensed North Carolina insurance agent (NPN #6608086) with 20+ years of experience. As an independent agency we represent multiple carriers and compare available options based on the customer’s needs and carrier eligibility.

## Services
- Auto Insurance (liability, comprehensive, collision, uninsured and underinsured motorist)
- Home Insurance (dwelling, personal property, liability, loss of use)
- [Mobile & Manufactured Home Insurance](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/mobile-home-quote) (HO-7 / MH(C) and MH(F) policies for single-wide, double-wide, modular, park-sited, and private-land homes across all 100 NC counties via Foremost, National General, and specialty carriers)
- [Renters Insurance](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/renters-insurance/) & [Landlord / Rental Property Insurance](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/landlord-insurance) (tenant belongings, liability, loss of use; rental property DP-3 dwelling protection via Steadily, NC Grange Mutual, and Foremost across NC)
- [Motorcycle, ATV & UTV Insurance](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/motorcycle-insurance/) (cruisers, touring, sport bikes, custom/classic, off-road and street-legal side-by-sides / Modified Utility Vehicles across NC)
- [Boat / Pontoon / PWC Insurance](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/boat-insurance/) (hull, liability, uninsured boater, trailer; NC boater-education and PWC rules explained)
- Personal Umbrella Insurance
- Classic Car Insurance (Hagerty)

## Home Insurance: Consent to Rate, Credit and Nonrenewal
- [NC Consent to Rate Explained](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/consent-to-rate/) - why a North Carolina home renewal shows two prices, the 2019 no-signature rule (N.C. Gen. Stat. 58-36-30), and what to do
- [Home Insurance With Less-Than-Perfect Credit](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/bad-credit-home-insurance-nc/) - NC Grange Mutual rates the house, not a credit-based insurance score, and does not use consent-to-rate pricing
- [Dropped Over a Trampoline, Pool, Dog or Outbuilding](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/trampoline-pool-dog-outbuilding-nc/) - NC Grange signed exclusion forms for a trampoline, pool, dog or outbuilding; 45-day nonrenewal notice rule
- [NC Consent to Rate Data by Territory and County, 2022-2025](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/consent-to-rate-data-nc/) - NC Department of Insurance aggregate consent-to-rate statistics for all 29 Rate Bureau homeowners territories (share of policies with a surcharge, average premium difference), county lookup, CSV/JSON download
- [NC Grange Mutual Home Insurance](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/nc-grange-mutual/) - North Carolina-only mutual, sold through independent agents; Bill Layne Insurance is an appointed agency
- [Universal Property & Casualty Home Insurance in NC](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/home-insurance/universal-property/) - Universal Property & Casualty homeowners coverage, deductibles, optional protections, and policy service tools with local guidance from Bill Layne Insurance
- [Foremost Mobile Home & Specialty Insurance in NC](https://www.billlayneinsurance.com/auto-center/carriers/foremost-north-carolina) - Foremost manufactured home, seasonal/vacant property, landlord, motorcycle, ATV, and RV coverage across North Carolina
